BSC21-006.name: Hotarumaru
BSC21-006.effect:
[When Braved]
While your "Catalyst"/ "Fencer"/"Exalted Sword" family Spirits/Ultimates are battling, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.

BSC21-008.name: Ichigo Hitofuri
BSC21-008.effect:
[When Braved] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack this Spirit at the start of the step if possible.

BSC21-009.name: Himetsuruichimonji
BSC21-009.effect:
This card doesn't count towards the total number of Braves that your exactly-named "The SwordsSaintPrincess Tsuru" can brave with.

[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Return a Yellow card from your Trash to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

BSC21-011.name: Ookurikara
BSC21-011.effect:
When your Cost 8 Ultimate is summoned, return this Brave card from your Trash to the Hand.

[When Braved]
Treat this Brave as Cost 2.

BSC21-004.name: Shishio
BSC21-004.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If this Burst was activated via [Catalyze], also, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

BSC21-002.name: The CleverMachineSwordMaster Ryoudan'ou
BSC21-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After the Burst activates, discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC21-005.name: The DemonBlade Murasame
BSC21-005.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit to their Reserve. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending a core from any opposing Spirit to another opposing Spirit, draw a card.

BSC21-X04.name: The GroundDeityBlade Ootenta
BSC21-X04.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Return an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, send the [Soul Core](Soul Core) from your Trash to this Spirit. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

BSC21-X02.name: The SwordMasterGeneral Kaidou Tsunoshige
BSC21-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can brave with up to two Braves.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Battles)
At the end of battle, once per turn, if this Spirit is braved with two Braves, refresh this Spirit.

BSC21-X03.name: The SwordMasterPrincess Tsuru
BSC21-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal up to five cards from your decktop. Add all cards with Burst effects among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

BSC21-X01.name: The SwordMasterWarDragon Mitsurugi-Dragon
BSC21-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
You can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts. For each opposing Spirit depleted/destroyed by that Burst effect, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

BSC21-003.name: The SwordMasterWisdomKing Shura
BSC21-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

BSC21-001.name: The SwordMasterWraith Eaglen
BSC21-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Catl: All Color] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

BSC21-010.name: The ThunderLifeBlade Mikazuki
BSC21-010.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent)
During this turn, every opposing Spirit/Nexus loses its effects, and can't gain new ones. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, at the end of the battle, by setting a Burst card from your Hand, refresh this Spirit.

BSC21-012.name: The WaterSupremeBlade Juzumaru
BSC21-012.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect)
Look at the opposing entire Hand, and discard a Magic card among them. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] (Your Attack Step)
This Spirit is treated as being on its highest level.

BSC21-007.name: The WindWingBlade Doujikiri
BSC21-007.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves)
Exhaust any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of Cost 12. After this effect resolves, summon this Brave card without paying the cost.

[When Braved] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
You can brave this Brave to another Spirit you control.
